origin.title: CSV export of reports
origin.text: Reports can be exported as CSV from the API and from the web page, and the export is logged for audit.

criteria.text: GET /reports/:id/export.csv returns the report as CSV
The reports page has an Export button that downloads it
Every export writes an audit log entry

children.title: Rewrite the export mapping, first half

acceptance_criteria: The header and the first six columns are rewritten

children.title: Rewrite the export mapping, second half
children.goal: Finish the edit begun in the other child: the remaining columns of buildCsvRows, which only compiles and passes once the first half is there
